title: Number of matching samples
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each index in $P$. For $R$ samples $(x_i,s_i)\in\{\pm1\}^n\times\{\pm1\}$, the match count is the number of indices $i<R$ for which $x_i$ agrees with $z$ on every index in $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite subset of the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$
$z$ assigns a sign to each index in $P$
Each sample is a cube point paired with a sign
